messages:
Sara L.: quick check — planning a tiny STS patch for my-inference: reduce replicas 5 -> 3, add a startupProbe to avoid flappy pods. I’ll do a canary (partition=1) then roll forward. tf changes + kubernetes patch. anyone object?
Dan M.: why drop replicas? traffic steady?
Sara L.: freeing a few GPUs for a short-lived training job, traffic is steady. also lowering sidecar cpu request 500m->250m to keep headroom.
Kai P.: @Sara L. make sure PVC retention semantics don't change. if you touch volumeClaimTemplates we need a migration plan.
Marco G.: paste the patch + tf plan link and I’ll skim.
Sara L.: plan: https://ci.internal/runs/3421 (public within org). patch I’ll apply via kubectl patch for canary first: ```kubectl patch sts my-inference --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/replicas","value":3},{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/startupProbe","value":{"httpGet":{"path":"/readyz","port":8080},"failureThreshold":30,"periodSeconds":10}}]'```
deploy-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled canary partition=1 for 30m, will alert #eng-oncall if errors > 5/min :robot_face:
Dan M.: also add a PodDisruptionBudget. with 3 replicas set minAvailable:1 so drains won't kill the app.
Sara L.: good call. I’ll add a PDB and a small readiness gate that blocks traffic until healthy. also adding a rollback alert: if 5xx rate > 2% for 10m, automation scales replicas back to 5.
Kai P.: update Terraform var default for replicas and add lifecycle ignore for volumeClaimTemplates so TF doesn't try to recreate PVCs. tf plan should be clean (only replicas + new pdb resource). ping me the plan output.
Marco G.: quick lgtm on probe shape, but can we lower failureThreshold to 20? 30 seems long for our observed startup.
Sara L.: ok 20 then. I'll run `tf plan -var 'replicas=3'` and post the diff shortly. targeting maintenance window 02:00 UTC.
Sara L. (02:22 UTC): update — applied canary, ran smoke tests, promoted to full rollout at 02:22. health checks stable, no increase in error rate. closing the loop. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
